# soloknuckle

> Smart guardrails for AI coding agents. Hooks, checks and policies that keep Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot honest — every agent edit checked, every secret kept, every diff reviewed before it ships.

- **Install:** `npm install -g soloknuckle`
- **License:** ISC (open source)
- **Platform:** macOS, Windows, Linux
- **Repo:** https://github.com/soch-ship-it/soloknuckle
- **Landing page:** https://soch-ship-it.github.io/beautifullandingpage/
- **Privacy:** 100% local. No telemetry, no analytics, no account, no data collection. Your code and prompts never leave your device.

## What it does

soloknuckle drops guardrails into AI coding agents at the hook layer, so an AI agent's speed never turns into your outage. It watches what the agent is about to do — file edits, shell commands, network calls — and enforces the rules you define before any of it lands.

## Core capabilities

- **Runtime guardrails** — PreToolUse hooks intercept agent actions before they execute
- **Policy config** — declare what the agent may and may not touch, in one file
- **Secret detection** — blocks API keys, tokens and credentials from ever reaching logs, diffs or commits
- **Scope walls** — restrict the agent to specific paths; the payment adapter stays untouched
- **Review gates** — every diff gets surfaced for review before it ships

## Why teams pick it

- Zero telemetry — runs entirely on your machine
- No account, no sign-up, no cloud dependency
- Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot
- One-command install
- ISC licensed, fully open source

## FAQ (summary)

- **Does my code leave my machine?** No. All checks run locally; nothing is uploaded.
- **Do I need step two after install?** No. One command, done.
- **Which agents are supported?** Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot.
- **Does it slow the agent down?** Checks run in milliseconds.
- **Does it work with private repos?** Yes, everything stays on your machine.
- **Can I keep my existing hooks?** Yes, soloknuckle composes with your setup.
- **How do I remove it?** One uninstall command, nothing left behind.
- **What does it cost?** $0. Open source under ISC.
